YOUTH-LED. EXPERIENCE-FUELED. CALIFORNIA-BASED.

Different generations.
Same spark.

Legacy Garage 26 brings young builders and experienced people together around a 1968 Chevrolet Corvair.

Be part of the story ↗
OUR STARTING POINT

The garage
is our classroom.

We’re learning by working on something real. The restoration gives us a reason to understand mechanical systems, use tools thoughtfully, solve problems together, and ask people with experience how they would approach the work.

The car is at the center, but the people matter just as much: owners who remember their first Corvair, mechanics who know where to look, and engineers who can turn a small detail into a bigger lesson.

WHAT DRIVES US
01

Learn by doing.

Turn curiosity into practical knowledge. Make room for questions, mistakes, and thoughtful problem solving.

02

Keep knowledge moving.

Listen to experienced people and help their stories and skills reach the next generation.

03

Tell the whole story.

Share the process, not just the finished result. Document discoveries, decisions, and the lessons between milestones.

THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE PROJECT

Young builders.
Experienced voices.
Room for you.

Our team brings together hands-on restoration, engineering, art, and storytelling. Get to know the people behind the project.

If you have Corvair experience, a story to tell, or a skill to share, we’d love to hear from you.

Meet the team ↗
ONE CAR IS JUST THE BEGINNING.

Preserve the past.
Build what’s next.

We want Legacy Garage 26 to become a place where younger generations discover classic cars, engineering, and the people who keep automotive culture alive.

Have a Corvair story to share?
